set.description: 시험대 상면 원점 screen(64,162), surfaceOffset(0,2). 다른 목재 지팡이 두 자루 11~12px×1px를 surface-local y3(화면165)에 놓는다. 실제 밝은 내부 host-local y2..9 중 첫4행을 사용한다.

slots.label: pair
slots.see: 표면 기준 localAlphaBounds[1,3,31,4); 각 16px 타일에 11~12px 지팡이 한 자루. screen y165, 상자 screen y162..164와 분리; LS/RS 실제 밝은 상면 안. 추가 바닥 점유 없음.

contract.camera: south above, orthogonal 3/4, no isometric side skew
contract.palette: theme-3e7ac64c5cf1d943e08a dedicated 42 colors; isolated palette.pal only
contract.registration: human choice required; production sheet is not installed as one object
contract.composition: actual work LS/RS bright interior host-local y2..9; use first four surface-local rows: boxes y0..2(screen162..164), wands y3(screen165); two of each stay separately readable
contract.coordinateSpace: screenOriginPx = 16*floorCell + floorToScreenOffset(0,32) + host.surfaceOffset; screenAlphaPx = screenOriginPx + slotLocalAlphaPx - stateOrigin(0,0)
contract.reuse: Existing images are geometry reference only; create dedicated native pixels from transparent seed.
